label: type II restriction-modification system
definition: A restriction-modification system in which an organism possesses a Type II restriction endonuclease activity paired with cognate methyltransferase self-protection, including conventional RM_Type_II loci represented by DefenseFinder.
observations: Type II restriction-modification branch under restriction-modification system; distinct from individual Type II restriction endonucleases, individual cognate methyltransferases, individual Type IIG fusion enzymes, the DefenseFinder RM_Type_II__Type_II_MTases and RM_Type_II__Type_II_REases profile groups, individual custom RM_Type_II HMM profiles, the RM_Type_II source key, isolated conventional Type II enzymes outside a complete R-M locus, specialized Type IIG subtype loci, and the broader restriction-modification parent.
